sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们还是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你制作了《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.en: Oh, Angela, we have a good episode today.
sentences.zh: 哦，安吉拉，我们今天这集很棒。

sentences.en: It is so good.
sentences.zh: 确实太棒了。

sentences.en: It's so simple, so wonderful, so much tension, conflict, a little bit of drama.
sentences.zh: 它既简单又精彩，充满了张力、冲突，还有一点点戏剧性。

sentences.en: It's all there and some laughs.
sentences.zh: 应有尽有，还有不少笑料。

sentences.en: It is called Did I Stutter?
sentences.zh: 这一集叫《我结巴了吗？》。

sentences.en: It is season four, episode 16, written by Brent Forrester and Justin Spitzer and directed by Randall Einhorn.
sentences.zh: 这是第四季第16集，由布伦特·福雷斯特和贾斯汀·斯皮策编剧，兰德尔·艾因霍恩执导。

sentences.en: We've got a lot to cover.
sentences.zh: 我们要讲的内容很多。

sentences.en: I say get into that summary, lady.
sentences.zh: 女士，快开始讲剧情梗概吧。

sentences.en: Here it is.
sentences.zh: 这就来。

sentences.en: Stanley challenges Michael's authority during a conference room meeting, leaving Michael speechless.
sentences.zh: 在会议室开会时，斯坦利挑战了迈克尔的权威，让迈克尔哑口无言。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Later, Michael responds to Stanley's insubordination by attempting to scare him into an attitude adjustment with a fake firing.
sentences.zh: 后来，迈克尔试图通过假装解雇斯坦利来吓唬他，让他调整态度，以此回应斯坦利的抗命行为。

sentences.en: What is with Michael and the fake firings?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔到底是怎么回事，老是搞假解雇这一套？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: He thinks it's like a go-to.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这是个万能招数。

sentences.en: I mean, it did not go well with Pam.
sentences.zh: 我是说，上次对帕姆用这招效果就很不好。

sentences.en: No, he should have abandoned this whole idea back then.
sentences.zh: 没错，他当时就该彻底放弃这个念头。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But he's still doing it.
sentences.zh: 但他还是在这么做。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Dwight decides to buy Andy's car at a discount only to immediately flip it for more money.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，德怀特决定低价买下安迪的车，然后转手高价卖出。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So shrewd.
sentences.zh: 真是精明。

sentences.en: Did he shrewd it?
sentences.zh: 他精明了吗？

sentences.en: He shrewded it.
sentences.zh: 他确实精明了一把。

sentences.en: Pam has to deal with the unexpected inconvenience of wearing her backup glasses to work after spending the night at a friend's house.
sentences.zh: 帕姆在朋友家过夜后，不得不戴着备用眼镜去上班，这让她感到非常不便。

sentences.en: Her backup glasses from junior high?
sentences.zh: 是她初中时的那副备用眼镜吗？

sentences.en: Perhaps.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I'll have a lot to share about that.
sentences.zh: 关于这点我有很多话要说。

sentences.en: I bet.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定。

sentences.en: I bet.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one.
sentences.zh: 第一个速览事实。

sentences.en: We're going to talk a little bit about the inspiration for this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊聊这一集的创作灵感。

sentences.en: We had a fan question from Bianca O and Katie W.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了粉丝比安卡·O和凯蒂·W的提问。

sentences.en: They wanted to know who came up with the idea for Stanley to sass Michael.
sentences.zh: 她们想知道是谁想出了让斯坦利顶撞迈克尔这个点子。

sentences.en: It was me.
sentences.zh: 是我。

sentences.en: No, I'm kidding.
sentences.zh: 开个玩笑。

sentences.en: Well, Angela, you do love a sass.
sentences.zh: 好吧，安吉拉，你确实很喜欢顶撞。

sentences.en: I love the sass.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这种顶撞。

sentences.en: Well, we traded messages with writer Brent Forrester about this episode,
sentences.zh: 我们和编剧布伦特·福雷斯特就这一集交换了信息，

sentences.en: and he told us he remembered being very excited when Greg assigned them the script because it was the biggest Stanley story he had ever done at that point.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，当格雷格把剧本分配给他们时，他记得自己非常兴奋，因为这是他当时写过的关于斯坦利篇幅最重的故事。

sentences.en: It was really the first time that Stanley had ever been the sole antagonist in a Michael story.
sentences.zh: 这确实是斯坦利第一次在迈克尔的故事线中成为唯一的反派。

sentences.en: I remember we were all so excited for Leslie.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们当时都为莱斯利感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Just as actors, to be able to have that big moment with Michael and to go head-to-head with Steve, that was like, you hoped for that, right?
sentences.zh: 作为演员，能和迈克尔有那种重头戏，还能和史蒂夫正面交锋，那感觉就像是你梦寐以求的，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, this was huge.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这太棒了。

sentences.en: Brent remembers Greg told him with great delight what the game of this episode was.
sentences.zh: 布伦特记得格雷格曾兴高采烈地告诉他这一集的“游戏规则”是什么。

sentences.en: It should be this.
sentences.zh: 应该是这个。

sentences.en: Michael is an overpowering boss to everyone in the office but is totally unable to stand up to one person, Stanley.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔在办公室里对每个人都是个强势的老板，但唯独对一个人完全没辙，那就是斯坦利。

sentences.en: No one ever dares to challenge Michael this blatantly, so when Stanley snaps at him, Michael just has no playbook for dealing with it.
sentences.zh: 从来没人敢这么公然挑战迈克尔，所以当斯坦利对他发火时，迈克尔根本不知道该怎么应对。

sentences.en: But he said that Mindy referred to this as reversal of status comedy, and it was the first time Brent had ever heard that term.
sentences.zh: 但他提到明迪把这称为“地位反转喜剧”，这是布伦特第一次听到这个术语。

sentences.en: Mindy, you're so smart.
sentences.zh: 明迪，你太聪明了。

sentences.en: I know, right?
sentences.zh: 我知道，对吧？

sentences.en: I remember doing Commedia dell'arte in theater school, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我记得我在戏剧学校学过意大利即兴喜剧。

sentences.en: No, here we go.
sentences.zh: 不，又要开始了。

sentences.en: Did you ever do Commedia?
sentences.zh: 你学过意大利即兴喜剧吗？

sentences.en: No, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 没有，珍娜。

sentences.en: I did my improv and my stand-up and my sketch comedy, so just let's hear it.
sentences.zh: 我做过即兴表演、单口喜剧和素描喜剧，所以让我们听听吧。

sentences.en: Well, it's really very interesting because Commedia dates back to long, long ago, and it is really all about status.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的很有趣，因为意大利即兴喜剧可以追溯到很久很久以前，它的核心其实就是地位。

sentences.en: And you're constantly switching status between these archetypal characters, and this has some real Commedia elements for all you theater nerds out there,
sentences.zh: 你需要在这些原型角色之间不断切换地位，对于你们这些戏剧迷来说，这集确实包含了一些真正的意大利即兴喜剧元素，

sentences.en: this reversal of status comedy.
sentences.zh: 这种地位反转喜剧。

sentences.en: No, it's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 不，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, even in improv, we would make someone, when you walk on stage, choose status, high or low.
sentences.zh: 我是说，即使在即兴表演中，当我们走上舞台时，也会让某人选择地位，高或低。

sentences.en: And if you constantly played high status, because some people, it's their go-to in comedy, our teacher would make you reverse it and play low status.
sentences.zh: 如果你总是扮演高地位角色，因为有些人这是他们的喜剧惯用手法，我们的老师就会让你反转过来，扮演低地位角色。

sentences.en: It was always a really cool exercise.
sentences.zh: 那一直是个非常酷的练习。

sentences.en: Okay, getting a little nerdy.
sentences.zh: 好了，有点书呆子气了。

sentences.en: Okay, we can move on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们可以继续了。

sentences.en: No, I love that we're nerding out on status comedy.
sentences.zh: 不，我喜欢我们钻研地位喜剧的样子。

sentences.en: Guys, watch comedy shows and look for status and reversal of status.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，看喜剧节目时留意一下地位和地位反转。

sentences.en: That's your homework.
sentences.zh: 这是你们的家庭作业。

sentences.en: We're making your television viewing homework now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在把你们看电视也变成家庭作业了。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: We're giving you homework.
sentences.zh: 我们在给你们布置作业呢。

sentences.en: Fast fact number two, Brent told us that this episode produced a mantra for the writer's room and a standard for which all episodes would now be held.
sentences.zh: 冷知识之二，布伦特告诉我们，这一集为编剧室产生了一个口号，也成为了衡量所有剧集的一个标准。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Here were the three words that applied to this episode that they believed make a great office episode.
sentences.zh: 以下是适用于这一集的三个词，他们认为这造就了伟大的《办公室》剧集。

sentences.en: Small, real, relatable.
sentences.zh: 小巧、真实、可感。

sentences.en: Brent said by normal TV standards, almost nothing happens in this episode.
sentences.zh: 布伦特说，按正常的电视标准，这一集里几乎什么都没发生。

sentences.en: Stan Lee insults Michael.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利侮辱了迈克尔。

sentences.en: Michael doesn't know how to respond.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔不知道该如何回应。

sentences.en: He said on any other show, this would have been considered a totally insufficient plot for 30 minutes of TV.
sentences.zh: 他说在任何其他节目中，这都会被认为是一个完全不足以支撑30分钟电视节目的情节。

sentences.en: But he said at this point in the series, they were so confident in the characters and their dynamics that they fully committed to this very subtle interpersonal story.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，在剧集的这个阶段，他们对角色及其互动非常有信心，以至于他们完全投入到了这个非常微妙的人际关系故事中。

sentences.en: And they wrote this slogan in the writer's room, small, real, relatable.
sentences.zh: 他们在编剧室写下了这个口号：小巧、真实、可感。

sentences.en: And he said that he believes that this is the signature of the office at its beSt.
sentences.zh: 他说他相信这就是《办公室》巅峰时期的标志。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I always love those types of episodes.
sentences.zh: 我一直很喜欢那种类型的剧集。

sentences.en: I mean, I know it comes before this one, but I felt like health care was in that vein, you know?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道它在这集之前，但我觉得《医疗保健》那一集也是这种风格，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But yeah, I love small, real, relatable.
sentences.zh: 但没错，我喜欢“小巧、真实、可感”。

sentences.en: I love that kind of comedy.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种喜剧。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: All right, fast fact number three, Angela, Pam's glasses.
sentences.zh: 好了，冷知识之三，安吉拉，帕姆的眼镜。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: We got a lot of mail.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多邮件。

sentences.en: Abby S.
sentences.zh: Abby S.

sentences.en: and Amy G.
sentences.zh: 和 Amy G.

sentences.en: want to know, Jenna, is your eyesight as bad as Pam's?
sentences.zh: 想问问 Jenna，你的视力有 Pam 那么差吗？

sentences.en: And then Kat F., Jessica M., and Rachel G.
sentences.zh: 然后 Kat F.、Jessica M. 和 Rachel G.

sentences.en: want to know how many pairs of glasses were given as options for this episode?
sentences.zh: 想知道这一集里提供了多少副眼镜作为选择？

sentences.en: I remember when we were filming this, at that time, you didn't need glasses.
sentences.zh: 我记得拍摄这一集的时候，那时你还不需要戴眼镜。

sentences.en: You had great eyesight.
sentences.zh: 你的视力很好。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I did not wear glasses.
sentences.zh: 我当时确实没戴眼镜。

sentences.en: I do now, but I didn't then.
sentences.zh: 我现在戴了，但那时没戴。

sentences.en: Those are totally fake glasses.
sentences.zh: 那些眼镜完全是道具。

sentences.en: Phil Shea came on over with his tray of frames.
sentences.zh: Phil Shea 带着他的眼镜托盘过来了。

sentences.en: Greg was there, and we went through, and I had to put them on, and we just talked about which ones did we like.
sentences.zh: Greg 也在场，我们一起挑选，我得把它们戴上，然后我们讨论了喜欢哪一副。

sentences.en: We did discuss, Angela, that these were frames that dated back to maybe, like, years for Pam.
sentences.zh: Angela，我们确实讨论过，这些镜框可能属于 Pam 好几年前的旧物了。

sentences.en: Like you said, are these her junior high glasses?
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，这是她初中时的眼镜吗？

sentences.en: Well, you said something interesting on the DVD commentary for this episode.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你在这一集的 DVD 评论音轨里说了一些有趣的话。

sentences.en: You said you gave yourself your own little actor backstory, right, that didn't exist on the page, hadn't been discussed with the writers.
sentences.zh: 你说你给自己设定了一个演员背景故事，对吧？剧本里没有写，也没和编剧讨论过。

sentences.en: And for you, these glasses were the pair that Pam leaves in the glove box of her car for just in case.
sentences.zh: 对你来说，这些眼镜是 Pam 放在车子手套箱里以备不时之需的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Here's the crazy thing about these glasses.
sentences.zh: 关于这些眼镜，有一件疯狂的事。

sentences.en: Greg really, really wanted for my eyes to look super giant when I put on the glasses.
sentences.zh: Greg 非常、非常希望我戴上眼镜后眼睛看起来超级大。

sentences.en: But in order for that to be true, they would have had to put a true prescription in the lenses to magnify my eyes.
sentences.zh: 但要实现这一点，他们必须在镜片里配上真正的度数来放大我的眼睛。

sentences.en: And I said, but then I wouldn't be able to see all day.
sentences.zh: 我说，但那样我一整天都看不清东西了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But listen to what Greg said.
sentences.zh: 但听听 Greg 说了什么。

sentences.en: Greg said, well, here's what we'll do.
sentences.zh: Greg 说，好吧，我们这样办。

sentences.en: We'll give you contact lenses to degrade your vision and then correct your vision with the glasses.
sentences.zh: 我们给你戴上隐形眼镜来降低你的视力，然后再用这副眼镜矫正你的视力。

sentences.en: Greg, what?
sentences.zh: Greg，你说什么？

sentences.en: And I said, that sounds like a lot of effort for these few scenes where Pam wears her glasses.
sentences.zh: 我说，为了 Pam 戴眼镜的那几场戏，这听起来也太费劲了。

sentences.en: I've never worn contacts before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没戴过隐形眼镜。

sentences.en: This sounds like it has the potential to be a real disaster.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很有可能演变成一场真正的灾难。

sentences.en: And possibly damaging to my future eyesight.
sentences.zh: 而且可能会损害我以后的视力。

sentences.en: So I told this to Lee as we were watching the episode.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在看这一集的时候，我把这件事告诉了 Lee。

sentences.en: I said, can you believe that Greg wanted me to wear like contact lenses and then glasses?
sentences.zh: 我说，你能相信吗？Greg 想让我戴隐形眼镜，然后再戴上眼镜？

sentences.en: And Lee said, oh, that would have been funny.
sentences.zh: Lee 说，哦，那一定会很有趣。

sentences.en: Greg was right.
sentences.zh: Greg 是对的。

sentences.en: You should have done it.
sentences.zh: 你应该照做的。

sentences.en: Oh, and I was like, oh, Greg will be so happy to hear that because everybody pooh-poohed this idea.
sentences.zh: 哦，我说，Greg 听到这个一定会很高兴，因为当时每个人都否定了这个想法。

sentences.en: Like props, hair and makeup, production.
sentences.zh: 比如道具组、发型和化妆组、制作组。

sentences.en: Everybody was like, Greg, the potential for mishap with this idea is too great.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说，Greg，这个想法出岔子的可能性太大了。

sentences.en: We can't have it.
sentences.zh: 我们不能这么做。

sentences.en: So Greg was very reluctant to let it go.
sentences.zh: 所以 Greg 很不情愿地放弃了。

sentences.en: But he did.
sentences.zh: 但他确实放弃了。

sentences.en: He was like, all right, fine, fine.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，行吧，行吧。

sentences.en: So I think Greg would be really happy to know that my husband backs up his idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为 Greg 如果知道我丈夫支持他的想法，一定会很高兴的。

sentences.en: Well, I have a few more tidbits about Pam's glasses, but I will sprinkle them into the episode as we say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于 Pam 的眼镜我还有一些小花絮，但正如我们所说，我会把它们穿插在这一集里讲。

sentences.en: And that finalizes my fast facts, lady.
sentences.zh: 我的速览事实就到此为止了，女士。

sentences.en: Well, I have two things to share.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有两件事要分享。

sentences.en: First of all, little tidbit from the DVD commentary.
sentences.zh: 首先，来自 DVD 评论音轨的一个小花絮。

sentences.en: Randall Einhorn, who directed this episode, said that the editor's assembly cut came in at 41 minutes.
sentences.zh: 本集导演兰德尔·艾因霍恩说，剪辑师的初剪版长达41分钟。

sentences.en: And then he took that 41 minutes and he got it down to 31 minutes for his director's cut.
sentences.zh: 然后他把这41分钟缩减到了31分钟，作为他的导演剪辑版。
31分钟。

sentences.en: He didn't want to lose any more.
sentences.zh: 他不想再删减了。

sentences.en: And they had to get it down to 22 minutes to air it on NBC.
sentences.zh: 但为了在NBC播出，他们必须缩减到22分钟。

sentences.en: So there are a ton of deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多被删减的片段。

sentences.en: But in addition to that, there's all these other scenes that they didn't even get to put in the deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，还有很多其他连删减片段里都没放进去的场景。

sentences.en: There's more.
sentences.zh: 还有更多。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Jenna, here's my big thing I wanted to share with you.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，这是我想和你分享的一件大事。

sentences.en: As I was prepping for the podcast, I found my shooting draft of Did I Stutter?
sentences.zh: 在准备播客时，我找到了《我结巴了吗？》这一集的拍摄剧本。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I found the script.
sentences.zh: 我找到了剧本。

sentences.en: With all of those lost scenes?

sentences.zh: 迈克尔简直不敢相信，达里尔现在竟然要跟他分享那些所谓的帮派深层内幕。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What do you do if you're disrespected in the gang?
sentences.zh: 如果在帮派里被人冒犯了该怎么办？

sentences.en: Daryl's going to tell him they do something called Fluffy Fingers.
sentences.zh: 达里尔告诉他，他们会用一种叫“挠痒痒”的方法。

sentences.en: And that is where you surprise the person by tickling them.
sentences.zh: 就是趁对方不注意去挠他们痒痒。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And you keep tickling them until they start to tickle you.
sentences.zh: 然后一直挠，直到对方也开始挠你。

sentences.en: And then you're just tickling each other.
sentences.zh: 接着你们就互相挠痒痒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then you're over it.
sentences.zh: 然后这事儿就过去了。

sentences.en: It's really effective, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说这招特别管用。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, wow.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔听完觉得，哇。

sentences.en: I didn't think that's how it went in the gangs.
sentences.zh: 我没想到帮派里竟然是这么处理问题的。

sentences.en: But okay.
sentences.zh: 不过好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Hey, Michael's like, all right.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔心想，行吧。

sentences.en: I guess I should try this.
sentences.zh: 我想我应该试试这个。

sentences.en: It's so great.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And both Steve and Craig play it perfectly.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫和克雷格都演得太完美了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，确实。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Jenna, there was a deleted scene where Michael tries to get up the courage
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你知道吗，有个删减片段是迈克尔试图鼓起勇气

sentences.en: to tickle Stanley to do the Fluffy Fingers.
sentences.zh: 去挠斯坦利痒痒，用那个“挠痒痒”大法。

sentences.en: It's insane.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Stanley is at the supply cabinet.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利当时正在储物柜那边。

sentences.en: He's kind of reaching up to grab something.
sentences.zh: 他正伸手去拿东西。

sentences.en: And Michael sneaks up behind him.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔悄悄溜到他身后。

sentences.en: And he holds his hands up like he's going to tickle him.
sentences.zh: 他举起双手，摆出要挠他痒痒的架势。

sentences.en: But then he just can't quite figure out how to do it.
sentences.zh: 但后来他实在不知道该怎么下手。

sentences.en: And Stanley doesn't even notice.
sentences.zh: 而斯坦利根本没察觉到。

sentences.en: And Michael backs away.
sentences.zh: 于是迈克尔又退了回去。

sentences.en: And then Michael has a deleted talking head where he says, it's not Daryl's fault.
sentences.zh: 后来迈克尔还有一个删减的采访镜头，他说，这不怪达里尔。

sentences.en: It was a great idea.
sentences.zh: 这是个好主意。

sentences.en: I just couldn't quite figure out how to do it.
sentences.zh: 只是我实在没搞明白该怎么操作。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I've tried everything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都试过了。

sentences.en: I'm running out of options.
sentences.zh: 我快没招了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And when you run out of options, you decide to fake fire someone.
sentences.zh: 当你没招的时候，你就会决定假装开除某个人。

sentences.en: That's what Michael does.
sentences.zh: 这就是迈克尔干的事。

sentences.en: Oh, Michael.
sentences.zh: 噢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So now Ryan has arrived.
sentences.zh: 现在瑞安到了。

sentences.en: He pulls up in his convertible.
sentences.zh: 他开着敞篷车过来了。

sentences.en: His shirt is open.
sentences.zh: 衬衫领口敞开着。

sentences.en: He winks at himself in the rearview mirror.
sentences.zh: 他对着后视镜里的自己眨了眨眼。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: He's feeling real good.
sentences.zh: 他感觉好极了。

sentences.en: And there was a deleted scene, Jenna, that was so good.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，还有一个删减片段特别精彩。

sentences.en: He comes in the office.
sentences.zh: 他走进办公室。

sentences.en: He's got bagels.
sentences.zh: 他带了百吉饼。

sentences.en: But Pam doesn't have her glasses on.
sentences.zh: 但帕姆没戴眼镜。

sentences.en: He tosses a bagel at her.
sentences.zh: 他把一个贝果扔向她。

sentences.en: She can't see it.
sentences.zh: 她没看见。

sentences.en: It hits her in the face.
sentences.zh: 贝果砸在了她脸上。

sentences.en: And then he goes on, Jenna, to show Pam how to eat a bagel.
sentences.zh: 然后他接着向帕姆演示怎么吃贝果。

sentences.en: He just, with his own hands, starts digging out all the good part of the bagel,
sentences.zh: 他直接用手把贝果里好吃的部分全掏了出来，

sentences.en: all the middle part.
sentences.zh: 把中间部分全掏空了。

sentences.en: And he says, yeah, you just eat that outer part, you know, so you don't gain weight.
sentences.zh: 他说，对，你就吃外圈就行，这样就不会长胖。

sentences.en: And he kind of points to Pam's belly.
sentences.zh: 他还指了指帕姆的肚子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I felt like that whole scene showed his state of mind, how manic he is,
sentences.zh: 我觉得整场戏展现了他的精神状态，他有多狂躁，

sentences.en: throwing the bagels, digging them apart.
sentences.zh: 扔贝果，把贝果掏得乱七八糟。

sentences.en: Like, oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪，真是。

sentences.en: I remember shooting that.
sentences.zh: 我记得拍那场戏的时候。

sentences.en: I was sad it didn't make it in because that was really fun.
sentences.zh: 没能剪进正片里我挺难过的，因为那场戏真的很有趣。

sentences.en: You were so good in it.
sentences.zh: 你在那场戏里演得太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, he's like, he tosses a bagel at you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他当时把贝果扔向你。

sentences.en: And Jenna, I really believed you didn't see it.
sentences.zh: 而且珍娜，我真的相信你当时没看见。

sentences.en: That's how good you are in the scene.
sentences.zh: 你在这场戏里的演技就是这么好。

sentences.en: Anyway, so Ryan is here.
sentences.zh: 总之，瑞安在那儿。

sentences.en: He's actually got some big business.
sentences.zh: 他其实是有什么大生意要谈。

sentences.en: He goes in the conference room and he calls Jim in.
sentences.zh: 他走进会议室，把吉姆叫了进去。

sentences.en: Toby's there and he's going to give him a formal warning about his job performance.
sentences.zh: 托比也在，他要就吉姆的工作表现对他进行正式警告。

sentences.en: But the way he calls him in is so amazing.
sentences.zh: 但他叫吉姆进去的方式简直绝了。

sentences.en: He's like, hey, Jim, Jim, I got to ask you a question as a true Eagles fan.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，吉姆，吉姆，作为真正的老鹰队球迷，我得问你个问题。

sentences.en: Oh, so slimy.
sentences.zh: 噢，太油腻了。

sentences.en: I thought BJ was so good in this scene.
sentences.zh: 我觉得BJ在这场戏里演得太好了。

sentences.en: He was like every douchebag I've ever had a meeting with.
sentences.zh: 他演出了我见过的所有混蛋那种感觉。

sentences.en: I actually recorded it off my computer and I texted it to him.
sentences.zh: 我甚至专门录下来发短信给了他。

sentences.en: And I said, BJ, we're watching Did I Stutter?
sentences.zh: 我说，BJ，我们正在看《我结巴了吗？》这一集。

sentences.en: And you are so brilliant and amazing in the scene.
sentences.zh: 你在戏里表现得太出色、太惊艳了。

sentences.en: I just needed you to watch it so you can see how good you are.
sentences.zh: 我就是想让你看看，让你知道自己演得有多好。

sentences.en: And he wrote me back and he was like, Jenna, oh, my God, I forgot about that scene.
sentences.zh: 他回我说，珍娜，天哪，我都忘了那场戏了。

sentences.en: Thank you for sending this to me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你发给我。

sentences.en: That was so fun to watch.
sentences.zh: 看这段真的太有意思了。

sentences.en: But that happens when we are rewatching this show.
sentences.zh: 但重温这部剧时经常会这样。

sentences.en: Sometimes I will see one of our friends perform just like madness level amazing.
sentences.zh: 有时我会看到我们的朋友演得简直好到疯狂。

sentences.en: And I just send it to him.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会发给他。

sentences.en: I'm like, you need to be reminded of what an amazing comedic actor you are.
sentences.zh: 我会说，你需要被提醒一下你是一位多么出色的喜剧演员。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 那当然。

sentences.en: I had a whole text thread with Phyllis because I was like, Phyllis, you are so amazing.
sentences.zh: 我之前还和菲利斯发过一长串短信，因为我说，菲利斯，你太棒了。

sentences.en: Back in Yankee Swap.
sentences.zh: 在《洋基交换礼物》那集里。

sentences.en: She's so good.
sentences.zh: 她演得太好了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: BJ is so good in these moments.
sentences.zh: BJ在这些时刻表现得太好了。

sentences.en: And Jim is like, is this because I talked to David Wallace?
sentences.zh: 吉姆问，这是因为我和大卫·华莱士谈过吗？

sentences.en: And Ryan's like, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 瑞安说，不，不，不。

sentences.en: I appreciate, you know, constructive criticism.
sentences.zh: 我很感激建设性的批评，你知道的。

sentences.en: I thrive on it.
sentences.zh: 我靠这个进步。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So douchey.
sentences.zh: 真够混蛋的。

sentences.en: And he says you can get more details from Toby.
sentences.zh: 他说你可以从托比那里得到更多细节。

sentences.en: This leads to a Toby talking head.
sentences.zh: 这引出了托比的单人采访。

sentences.en: And dare I say that Toby seems smug?
sentences.zh: 我敢说托比看起来很自鸣得意吗？

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Toby says, I'd say all the goofing around at Pam's desk and hanging out with Pam has finally caught up with him.
sentences.zh: 托比说，我会说在帕姆桌边胡闹以及和帕姆混在一起，终于让他自食其果了。

sentences.en: Fans were furious, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 粉丝们很愤怒，珍娜。

sentences.en: When this episode came out, they hated Toby so much.
sentences.zh: 这一集播出时，他们非常讨厌托比。

sentences.en: I mean, in the episode before, he put his hand on Pam's knee.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在上一集里，他把手放在了帕姆的膝盖上。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And now it seems like he's going behind Jim's back to try to get him fired.
sentences.zh: 现在看起来他好像在背后搞小动作，想让吉姆被解雇。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: And Jenna, if you thought you hated Toby with that talking head, had you seen the deleted scene between Jim and Toby?
sentences.zh: 珍娜，如果你觉得那个单人采访让你讨厌托比的话，你有没有看过吉姆和托比之间那段被删掉的戏？

sentences.en: And then Ryan, you would have been like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 如果是那样的话，瑞安，你当时肯定会觉得，天哪。

sentences.en: People would have, Toby would not have been able to come back from it.
sentences.zh: 人们会觉得，托比根本没法从那件事里翻身了。

sentences.en: Sam, can you play that deleted scene?
sentences.zh: 山姆，你能播放那段被删掉的戏吗？

sentences.en: A formal warning.
sentences.zh: 正式警告。

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 说真的。

sentences.en: Well, as you know, Dwight has filed a lot of complaints against you over the years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如你所知，多年来德怀特对你投诉了很多次。

sentences.en: And no one cared.
sentences.zh: 但没人理会。

sentences.en: But now it's being looked at as more of a productivity issue.
sentences.zh: 可现在这件事被视为一个生产力问题。

sentences.en: Productivity?
sentences.zh: 生产力？

sentences.en: My numbers are good.
sentences.zh: 我的业绩很好。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: But Ryan thinks that they're not good enough.
sentences.zh: 但瑞安认为还不够好。

sentences.en: Wallace likes Jim.
sentences.zh: 华莱士喜欢吉姆。

sentences.en: So going after him, that's a risky move for me.
sentences.zh: 所以针对他，对我来说是个冒险的举动。

sentences.en: But in business, you've got to take risks.
sentences.zh: 但在商场上，你必须冒险。

sentences.en: Sometimes you've got to get out on the open highway with a top down.
sentences.zh: 有时候你得开着敞篷车行驶在开阔的高速公路上。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And Ryan is trying to put the top down to his car and it won't go down.
sentences.zh: 瑞安正试图把他的车顶篷放下来，但放不下来。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But, yeah, can you imagine if those scenes have been left in?
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，你能想象如果那些戏份被保留下来会怎样吗？

sentences.en: Oh, well, Angela, speaking of treachery, Dwight has washed the Xterra and he's now reselling it for over $9,000.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，安吉拉，说到背叛，德怀特洗了那辆Xterra，现在正以超过9000美元的价格转卖。

sentences.en: He's selling it for a profit.
sentences.zh: 他在靠这个赚钱。

sentences.en: Oh, and Andy is like, what the hell, man?
sentences.zh: 哦，安迪当时就像是，搞什么鬼，伙计？

sentences.en: Angela's impressed.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉印象深刻。

sentences.en: Angela's like, oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉就像是，哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You got him.
sentences.zh: 你赢了他。

sentences.en: You're smarter.
sentences.zh: 你更聪明。

sentences.en: She loves two men dueling over her.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢看两个男人为她争斗。

sentences.en: She really does.
sentences.zh: 她确实喜欢。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You guys remember, Michael has run out of options.
sentences.zh: 你们还记得吗，迈克尔已经别无选择了。

sentences.en: Fluffy fingers isn't going to work for him.
sentences.zh: “毛茸茸的手指”那招对他不管用了。

sentences.en: So he's going to have to do the thing he didn't want to do.
sentences.zh: 所以他不得不去做他不想做的事。

sentences.en: He's going to have to fake fire Stanley to teach him a lesson.
sentences.zh: 他不得不假装解雇斯坦利来给他一个教训。

sentences.en: And he comes out of his office and he announces it to everyone.
sentences.zh: 然后他走出办公室，向大家宣布了这件事。

sentences.en: He says, guys, guys, guys, listen, I'm going to fake fire Stanley, but I just want you to react as if I'm really firing Stanley.
sentences.zh: 他说，伙计们，听着，我要假装解雇斯坦利，但我希望你们表现得就像我真的在解雇他一样。

sentences.en: And everybody's like, if you hadn't told us what you were doing, we would have reacted correctly.
sentences.zh: 大家心想，如果你没告诉我们你要做什么，我们本来就会做出正确的反应。

sentences.en: And he's like, oh, my gosh, why aren't you understanding this?
sentences.zh: 他却说，天哪，你们为什么就是不明白呢？

sentences.en: The person that says it, the person that's the voice of reason is Kevin.
sentences.zh: 说出这句话的人，那个理智的声音，是凯文。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You know you're in trouble when Kevin is the voice of reason.
sentences.zh: 当凯文都成了理智的化身时，你就知道麻烦大了。

sentences.en: Stanley walks into the bullpen and Michael fake fires him.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利走进办公区，迈克尔假装解雇了他。

sentences.en: And it does not go well.
sentences.zh: 结果并不顺利。

sentences.en: Stanley unleashes on him.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利对他大发雷霆。

sentences.en: Just a tirade of insults.
sentences.zh: 简直是一连串的辱骂。

sentences.en: I remember when we filmed this, Jenna, and you could have heard a pin drop.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我记得我们拍这一段的时候，现场安静得连根针掉在地上都能听见。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was such a beautifully dramatic moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常精彩的戏剧性时刻。

sentences.en: Leslie crushed it.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利演得太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you guys, we reached out to Leslie because we really,
sentences.zh: 是啊，大家，我们联系了莱斯利，因为我们真的，

sentences.en: really wanted him to come on the pod today because this is just a tour de force storyline and performance by him in this episode.
sentences.zh: 真的非常希望他今天能来参加播客，因为他在这一集里的表演和剧情简直是巅峰之作。

sentences.en: And he is filming this week.
sentences.zh: 但他这周在拍戏。

sentences.en: He is filming something and he couldn't come on.
sentences.zh: 他在拍别的东西，所以没能过来。

sentences.en: But he did want us to share with you that this monologue was completely scripted.
sentences.zh: 但他确实想让我们告诉大家，这段独白是完全照着剧本演的。

sentences.en: This was not improvised.
sentences.zh: 这不是即兴发挥。

sentences.en: You know, and I remember, Angela, that he worked on this and he delivered it like it was just an amazing performance.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我记得他为了这段戏下了很大功夫，呈现出的表演令人惊叹。

sentences.en: And he nailed it every take.
sentences.zh: 每一条他都演得完美无缺。

sentences.en: Every take.
sentences.zh: 每一条都是。

sentences.en: He was 100% off book.
sentences.zh: 他完全背下了台词。

sentences.en: He showed up ready to throw it down.
sentences.zh: 他做好了全力以赴的准备。

sentences.en: And we were just all so happy for him.
sentences.zh: 我们都为他感到高兴。

sentences.en: This moment was amazing.
sentences.zh: 这一刻太精彩了。

sentences.en: And I remember us all applauding at the end of the scene.
sentences.zh: 我记得在那场戏结束时，我们所有人都为他鼓掌。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, Michael throws everybody out.
sentences.zh: 好吧，迈克尔把所有人都赶了出去。

sentences.en: He yells and says, everybody get out.
sentences.zh: 他大喊着说，所有人都出去。

sentences.en: Everybody.
sentences.zh: 所有人。

sentences.en: Except Stanley.
sentences.zh: 除了斯坦利。

sentences.en: Everybody out.
sentences.zh: 都出去。

sentences.en: And everyone gets the hell out.
sentences.zh: 于是大家全都滚蛋了。

sentences.zh: 珍娜，在剧本里——虽然删减片段里没有——迈克尔转向摄像机说，你们两台摄像机也给我出去。

sentences.en: Everybody.
sentences.zh: 所有人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that's why at 18 minutes, 17 seconds, you see the cameras sneak back in.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在18分17秒时，你会看到摄像机又偷偷溜了回来。

sentences.en: It's because in the script, Michael told them to get out.
sentences.zh: 因为在剧本里，迈克尔确实让他们出去了。

sentences.en: I loved that move.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个设计。

sentences.en: I loved it because when Michael is alone with Stanley or thinks he's alone with Stanley, he gets really vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它是因为当迈克尔和斯坦利单独相处，或者以为只有他们两人时，他会变得非常脆弱。

sentences.en: There's tears in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他眼里含着泪水。

sentences.en: And he says, why do you pick on me?
sentences.zh: 他说，你为什么要针对我？

sentences.en: Like, why do you pick on me like this?
sentences.zh: 就是说，你为什么要这样针对我？

sentences.en: And it's really vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 那一刻真的很脆弱。

sentences.en: And Stanley, very matter-of-factly, says, I don't respect you.
sentences.zh: 而斯坦利非常客观地回答说，我不尊重你。

sentences.en: And then I felt like Michael had such an honest moment that could not have happened if the cameras were there, where he says, fine, I accept that.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得迈克尔有了一个非常坦诚的时刻，如果摄像机在场的话，这一幕是不可能发生的，他说，好吧，我接受。

sentences.en: You don't respect me.
sentences.zh: 你不尊重我。

sentences.en: I accept it.
sentences.zh: 我接受。

sentences.en: But you can't talk to me like that here.
sentences.zh: 但你不能在这里那样跟我说话。

sentences.en: I am your boss.
sentences.zh: 我是你的上司。

sentences.en: And it just cannot be done.
sentences.zh: 而且这根本行不通。

sentences.en: And I agree with you, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: Anytime Michael knows the cameras are there, he can't help but perform in some way for them.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔只要知道摄像机在场，就忍不住要在那儿表演一番。

sentences.en: And so I feel like we're seeing a side of Michael Scott that can only be seen when he doesn't know the cameras are there.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉我们看到了迈克尔·斯科特只有在不知道摄像机在场时才会展现的一面。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was such a fun part of our show, playing with who are our characters when we know the cameras are there and when we don't.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们剧集里非常有趣的一部分，即探讨角色在知道和不知道摄像机在场时会有什么不同。

sentences.en: And I loved that we got to reveal these little different parts of ourselves in these different ways.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们能以这种方式展现出角色身上那些细微的不同侧面。

sentences.en: Oh, me too.
sentences.zh: 哦，我也是。

sentences.en: It made the show so rich, right?
sentences.zh: 这让剧集内容变得非常丰富，对吧？

sentences.en: It's cool.
sentences.zh: 这很酷。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: They have this moment of resolution.
sentences.zh: 他们达成了和解。

sentences.en: They're like, fine.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是说，好吧。

sentences.en: We now know our rules of engagement, right?
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道彼此的相处规则了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, they shake hands.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们握手言和了。

sentences.en: Done.
sentences.zh: 搞定。

sentences.zh: 这引出了迈克尔的一段采访镜头。

sentences.en: He's really stuck on the idea of respect, getting no respect.
sentences.zh: 他真的纠结于“尊重”这个概念，觉得没人尊重他。

sentences.en: And this just sends his brain into Rodney Dangerfield land.
sentences.zh: 这让他的大脑直接进入了罗德尼·丹格菲尔德的频道。

sentences.en: So he's going to do some real kind of like off-the-cuff Rodney Dangerfield impressions,
sentences.zh: 所以他开始做一些即兴的罗德尼·丹格菲尔德模仿秀，

sentences.en: which morphs into a Jeff Foxworthy impression and then Borat and then Jerry Seinfeld and then back to Rodney Dangerfield again.
sentences.zh: 接着又变成了杰夫·福克斯沃西，然后是波拉特，再然后是杰瑞·宋飞，最后又回到了罗德尼·丹格菲尔德。

sentences.zh: 那真是一段史诗级的采访镜头。

sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道吗，珍娜，那段采访，整段罗德尼·丹格菲尔德的喜剧即兴表演并不在拍摄剧本里。

sentences.zh: 而这是他们最终选用的版本，因为它不在剧本里。

sentences.zh: 他们正准备回家。

sentences.zh: 愿你前路皆是下坡，风儿常伴你的后挡风玻璃。

sentences.en: And Angela's like, Andy.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说，安迪。

sentences.zh: 安迪说，我真不敢相信德怀特会那样对我。

sentences.zh: 他利用了我的善良。

sentences.zh: 安吉拉说，他并没有占你便宜。

sentences.zh: 它就在删减片段里，吉姆告诉了帕姆关于瑞安的真相，以及瑞安对他说了什么，

sentences.zh: 哦，我把它命名为“帕姆发火了”。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 萨姆，你得播放那个片段。

sentences.zh: 嘿，今天到底发生了什么？

sentences.zh: 今天发生了什么？

sentences.zh: 天哪，他真是个混蛋。

sentences.zh: 然后接着是这个帕姆说要往瑞安身上扔石头，或者可能要用
